Problem: sockfarms mint keys faster than sealers can filter noise.
Mechanism: gate weight behind a 42h shale stake of 0.11 POA plus 5 non-kin seals; a falcon sortition then hashes key id with a 4h window so one operator's clones share one draw slot, and a rotating plume quota caps 2 seats per operator per epoch.
Cost: 0.11 POA locked and five seals.
Verification: stake txid, five seal receipts, and quota-hash logs must match before weight settles.
Failure: kin-linked seals or quota collision burn 45% of the stake and freeze the key one epoch.
